title: W3C SCXML statechart conformance fixture catalog
description: Editor/IDE aid only. Runtime validation is hand-rolled in sce-build/src/w3c_registry.rs, and `w3c_registry_matches_the_schema_file` keeps the two descriptions of the shape in lockstep so this file cannot drift into fiction. Not a wire surface — it is a repository input, not a produced record, so it carries no x-sce-schema-status and is absent from SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md, matching tests/forge/conformance/fixtures.schema.json.

version.description: Catalog format version. Bumped only for a change no reader can absorb additively.

harnesses.description: Every harness a fixture may name, mapped to what the runner has to do differently for it. A fixture naming a harness absent from this map is rejected at load, so the map is the closed set rather than documentation of one.

id.description: Upstream W3C test id, optionally with a variant suffix (403a). Names resources/<id>/ and must be unique across the catalog.

harness.description: Key into `harnesses`. Absent is not permitted: the default lives in the loader, not in each entry, so a reader never has to know it.

summary.description: This repository's curation note for the fixture, shown by `generate-w3c --list`. Distinct from the upstream description in resources/<id>/metadata.txt, which the generator reads separately and which this must not duplicate.
